function.name: find_image_duplicates
function.description: Read-only image duplicate detection with optional local or SSH CopyNCE. The host must explicitly grant model use, bind private remote profiles, and separately authorize uploads. Never delete or modify original images; never accept credentials in tool arguments.

paths.description: Selected local directories or image files within host-authorized roots. Empty ONLY for a host-authorized remote_directory query.

mode.description: exact: raw SHA-256; pixels: decoded pixels; similar: static whole-image similarity; copynce: experimental whole-image and region copy candidates.

output_dir.description: A NEW absolute report subdirectory under the host-approved report root.

recursive.description: Whether to include subdirectories. Normally true.

include_hidden.description: Include hidden entries only when requested. Normally false.

similarity_threshold.description: Optional ONLY for similar mode: the single similarity control. Higher is stricter. Recommended 90, normal range 80–95, 100 requires strict full-resolution pixel equality. Not a probability.

backend.description: Only copynce. Cloud uses a host-bound private profile; it never authorizes upload by itself.

model_threshold.description: Only fast copynce. Raw cosine threshold; requires domain calibration, not a probability.

whole_only.description: Only copynce. Compare whole images only; otherwise include fixed overlapping crop windows.

search_mode.description: Only copynce. Exact compares every selected feature pair; indexed may miss candidates.

top_k.description: Only copynce. Maximum returned image pairs; report states whether results were truncated.

remote_profile.description: Only cloud. An anonymous ID explicitly bound by the host; never an address, username, password or key path.

remote_directory.description: Only cloud with empty paths. Must be inside the current host-authorized remote root.

model_quality.description: enhanced uses Descriptor + official query-side SN + Matcher. deep uses the pinned official-code LCE. Legacy omitted quality means fast.

sn_background.description: Optional override for local enhanced/deep. Omit to use the bundled 1,000-image Open Images SN background. If supplied, use an anonymous index ID registered by the host, never a file path. Cloud background is selected on the server, which uses the bundled background when no custom index is configured.

candidate_k.description: Per-image candidate allowance per retrieval channel; separate from returned top_k.

matcher_budget.description: Maximum image pairs to verify; unfinished planned pairs mark the task incomplete.

local_view_pairs.description: Maximum selected local view pairs per direction, in addition to whole-image verification.

sn_extra_budget.description: Additional candidates allocated with official SN across queries.

matcher_threshold.description: Only enhanced/deep. Uncalibrated classifier score threshold; independent of cosine and SN scores.
